messages.text: Kicking off the Growth price thread. Win rate on Growth deals is 34% at $299 and we're underpriced vs Crate & Ladle by ~$60/location.
Competitive sheet agrees. Crate & Ladle Growth-equivalent is $359.
Please don't surprise existing customers. Last time we changed invoice-scanning limits we got 40 tickets in a day :sweat_smile:
anyone have the figma link for the new pricing page?
Modelled it: $349 for new Growth customers adds ~$310k ARR over 12 months at current pipeline. Grandfathering existing customers for 6 months costs us ~$95k.
lunch order for the Portland office is in, tacos again :taco:
Decision: Growth goes from $299 to $349 per location per month for new customers starting October 1, 2026. Existing customers keep $299 through March 31, 2027, then move to $349 at renewal.
Wren owns customer comms for the change. Tobias owns reissuing the pricing sheet by September 30.
On it. Keiko and I will send the grandfathering email to existing Growth accounts by September 22.
Reminder: HubSpot price books need updating before Oct 1 or quotes will go out at $299.
Marisol, can you own the HubSpot price book update? Due September 29.
We're also agreed that Starter stays at $149, right? Nobody's proposed changing it.
Correct. Starter stays at $149 for 2026. We'll revisit in the 2027 plan.
